key_idea: Order is irrelevant: sort pitches and greedily start a new recording at the smallest uncovered pitch, covering everything within d of it.
sketch: Sort, then repeatedly take the smallest remaining pitch x and skip all pitches <= x+d, counting groups. O(n log n). Pitfalls: d=0 groups equal pitches together, and x+d can reach 2e9 so use 64-bit.
